Welcome home

Room to spread out, close to everything

The Villas of Pine Valley is a community of two-bedroom, two-bath apartments on Pine Valley Drive in Elizabethtown. Homes include features like vaulted ceilings, balconies, ceiling fans, a dishwasher and washer/dryer hookups, and pets are welcome.

Shopping, dining and Freeman Lake Park are a short drive away, downtown Elizabethtown is about 13 minutes, and Fort Knox is about 30.

Pets welcome

Bring the whole family

Pets are part of the community here. Registering a pet takes three steps:

  1. Apply for each pet at PetScreening.com. It's required for every animal living in the home.
  2. PetScreening verifies records and gives your pet a paw score.
  3. They tell you the costs: the one-time pet fee and monthly pet rent.

The Etown Dog Park and Freeman Lake Park are both a short drive away.

    Leasing questions

    Good to know

    How do I find out what's available?
    Send a Check availability request, call or text us. We'll reply with the apartments open around your move-in date and current pricing.
    Can I tour before I apply?
    Yes. Request a tour with the tour form or call us to set a time. You can also walk through an apartment online with the 3D tour.
    How do I apply?
    Applications are online. When you're ready, use the Apply link.
    Are pets allowed?
    Yes, we're a pet-friendly community. Each pet is registered through PetScreening.com, which sets the one-time pet fee and monthly pet rent. See the pet policy.
    Is smoking allowed?
    No. Our apartments are smoke-free.
    When is the leasing office open?
    Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Call for Saturday hours; we're closed Sunday.
    I'm a current resident. Where do I pay rent or request maintenance?
    Use the resident login.

    We'll reply with the apartments open around your date and current pricing. Want to see one first? Tick "schedule a tour" and tell us what times work.

    Pet Policy

    The Villas of Pine Valley is a pet-friendly community!

    All Applicants/Residents bringing an animal or pet into the home are required to submit an application using PetScreening.com. PetScreening.com will verify animal or pet records and information and then provide a paw score. At this time PetScreening.com will inform Applicants/Residents of the amount of Non-Refundable Pet Fees and Monthly Pet Rent.

    Contact us for more details at 270-737-2715.

    Privacy Policy

    Last Updated: 12/9/2025

    This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit our site (the "Site") or provide information to us, including in connection with our text messaging programs.

    Personal Information We Collect

    When you visit the Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including information about your web browser, IP address, time zone, and some of the cookies installed on your device. Additionally, as you browse the Site, we collect information about the individual pages or products that you view, the websites or search terms that referred you to the Site, and information about how you interact with the Site. We refer to this automatically-collected information as "Device Information."

    We collect Device Information using the following technologies:

    • Cookies are data files that are placed on your device or computer and often include an anonymous unique identifier. For more information about cookies, and how to disable cookies, visit www.allaboutcookies.org.
    • Log files track actions occurring on the Site, and collect data including your IP address, browser type, Internet service provider, referring/exit pages, and date/time stamps.
    • Web beacons, tags, and pixels are electronic files used to record information about how you browse the Site.

    How Do We Use Your Personal Information?

    We use the Device Information that we collect to help us screen for potential risk and fraud (in particular, your IP address), and more generally to improve and optimize our Site. This includes generating analytics about how our visitors browse and interact with the Site, and assessing the success of our marketing and advertising campaigns.

    SMS/Text Messaging

    When you provide your mobile telephone number to us, you consent to receive text messages from Villas of Pine Valley related to your inquiries, leasing information, community updates, appointment reminders, maintenance notifications, and other property- or residency-related communications.

    You can opt out of receiving text messages at any time by replying STOP to any text message we send. After you send STOP, you may receive a final confirmation message to confirm that you have been unsubscribed. If you need assistance, you may reply HELP or contact our leasing office using the information on our Contact page.

    We do not sell or share your mobile telephone number with unaffiliated third parties for their own marketing purposes. Your mobile number is used solely to provide you with the services and communications you have requested or that are reasonably related to your relationship with our community. Standard message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile carrier and plan.

    Sharing Your Personal Information

    We share your Personal Information with third parties to help us use your Personal Information as described above. We use Google Analytics to help us understand how our customers use the Site—you can read more about how Google uses your Personal Information here: https://policies.google.com/privacy. You can also opt out of Google Analytics here: https://tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

    Finally, we may also share your Personal Information to comply with applicable laws and regulations, to respond to a subpoena, search warrant, or other lawful request for information we receive, or to otherwise protect our rights.

    Do Not Track

    Please note that we do not alter our Site's data collection and use practices when we see a Do Not Track signal from your browser.

    Your Rights

    If you are a European resident, you have the right to access personal information we hold about you and to ask that your personal information be corrected, updated, or deleted. If you would like to exercise this right, please contact us through the contact information below.

    Additionally, if you are a European resident, we note that we are processing your information in order to pursue our legitimate business interests. Please note that your information may be transferred outside of Europe, including to the United States.

    Data Retention

    When you provide personal information on the Site, we will maintain your Personal Information for our records unless and until you ask us to delete this information.

    Minors

    The Site is not intended for individuals under the age of 16. If you are under the age of 16, you must ask your parent or guardian before you use the Site, submit any information to us, or purchase any resources on the Site.

    Changes

    We may update this privacy policy from time to time in order to reflect, for example, changes to our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons.

    Unsubscribe from Our Mailings and Emails

    If you decide to unsubscribe from our mailings or emails, simply click "unsubscribe" at the bottom of any email, or contact us using the contact information below.

    Contact Us

    For more information about our privacy practices, if you have questions, or if you would like to make a complaint, please contact us using one of the methods on our Contact page.

    Accessibility

    The Villas of Pine Valley wants everyone to be able to learn about our community and reach our leasing office, including people who use assistive technology.

    What we've done

    • The page can be used with a keyboard, and focus is clearly visible.
    • Photos have text descriptions, and form fields have labels and error messages.
    • Text and buttons are designed for readable contrast, and the page respects your device's reduced-motion setting.
    • It works on phones, tablets and computers, and with browser zoom.

    Known limitations

    • The 3D tour and the neighborhood map come from outside providers and may be hard to use with a screen reader. The floor plan, photos and drive-time list cover the same information, and we're happy to describe anything by phone.
    • The contact form sends your request through your own email app. If that doesn't work for you, call or text us instead.

    Tell us if something doesn't work

    Call 270-737-2715, text us, or email brantinghamproperties@gmail.com. Tell us the problem and we'll help you get the information another way.
